title: Had a Vivid Dream
content: I created these with AI. The first picture is close to what the mall looks like. Then I went somewhere different. I followed someone on foot to this area. An island surrounded by screens showing other things going on in real time. At one point I fell off the ledge and could not figure out time and space, as I was falling/floating in a void of stacked video cubes. The only thing that centered me was this island. After what seemed like forever I finally was able to float back up to it I really tried to get AI to visualize it but it just wouldn’t. So it’s similar to the island in pic 2 but the space around it looks more like pic 3.
